data.title: Merge Conflict
data.tagline: When the same content was changed differently on two branches, Git cannot choose and a person must decide what to keep
data.description: When Git cannot automatically reconcile changes while merging main and feature/new-nav—for example, both changed the same heading in index.html—it pauses and writes both versions with conflict markers. Review the surrounding page and understand each branch's intent, then choose or reconcile the heading while retaining the other branch's needed navigation. Remove the markers, finish the merge, and reopen the page to verify the result. Markers do not say which side is correct.

use: Find the conflicted files and open them
Keep the correct result after understanding both sides
Stage and commit only after markers are gone
Rerun the project to confirm both sides still work
avoid: Commit with any conflict marker left in the file
Delete a whole section without reading the other side
Treat git merge --abort as resolution: it only returns to the pre-merge state, leaving changes unmerged
Mix unrelated edits into the conflict resolution
scenarios: Title markers and changes from both branches

lessonPractice.title: The homepage title conflicts, and the feature branch also adds navigation. How do you keep the right title and preserve the navigation?

options.label: Review the surrounding file, reconcile the title, keep needed navigation, remove markers, then commit
options.feedback: Correct. Read both title versions and the file context; retain the feature branch navigation while resolving the conflict, then reopen the page to verify it.

options.label: Take main's version for the whole section and discard the feature branch navigation
options.feedback: You may choose main's heading, but replacing the whole section would also remove the navigation added by the feature branch.

options.label: Take the feature version for the whole section without checking main's other content
options.feedback: Taking only one side can discard needed main-branch content; review the surrounding lines and additions first.

data.agentPrompt: Merging feature/new-nav conflicts in the index.html heading. Explain what main and feature changed; keep an appropriate heading and the other branch's new navigation, along with main's existing contact content. Make only the needed edits, remove all markers, then stage and finish the merge. Reopen the page and check both heading and navigation.
